parsed.explanation: No visitor-facing restriction is documented: no criminalisation of trans identity/expression, no facility ban, no border/document friction, no police targeting, and no violence record. Positives are in force — anti-discrimination statute enabling prosecution of transphobia, facilitated legal gender change, marriage equality — all national law applying here unchanged. The negative is custody: trans women imprisoned under legal-sex assignment and a 2021 watchdog finding of serious persistent violations against trans detainees, an unremedied institutional exposure (tier 1) but one only reached if a visitor is detained, so low probability, and dated. Department-specific silence is mild positive evidence given national-level documentation exists, though visitor-specific acceptance and current enforcement remain open questions. No universal-exposure measure or organised targeting appears. Reduced Risk, held below low-risk bands by the custody pattern and thin visitor-specific record.
